Dear Sirs, 
 
Sub: 
Intimation of Earnings Conference Call to discuss the Consolidated and 
Standalone Unaudited Financial Results of Kotak Mahindra Bank for the quarter 
and half-year ended September 30, 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations"), we wish to inform you that Kotak 
Mahindra Bank Limited (“Bank”) will hold an Earnings Conference Call to discuss the Consolidated and 
Standalone Unaudited Financial Results of the Bank for the quarter and half-year ended  
September 30, 2026, on Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. (IST), after the said Financial Results 
have been disseminated to the Stock Exchanges.  
 
Please find below the dial in details for the Earnings Call: 
 
Universal Dial in 
+91 22 6280 1215 / +91 22 7115 8116 
Pre‐registration Link 
Diamond Pass Registration 
 
The Investor Presentation on the said Financial Results, the audio recording and the transcript of the 
Earnings 
Conference 
Call 
will 
be 
put 
up 
on 
the 
Bank's 
website 
at 
https://www.kotak.bank.in/en/investor-relations/financial-results.html, 
in 
accordance 
with 
Regulation 46 of the Listing Regulations.  
 
This intimation is also being put up on the Bank’s website https://www.kotak.bank.in/en/investor-
relations/governance/sebi-listing-disclosures.html in terms of the Listing Regulations.  
 
We request you to take the above on record and disseminate the same on your website. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited  
 
 
 
Avan Doomasia
